blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Rank counts only communities with at least ten homes listed. Falling listings with steady sales mean homes are being absorbed faster; rising listings with steady sales mean more choice for buyers. A sellers’ best bet is a community where homes sell quickly against the number listed; a buyers’ best bet is the reverse. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Between June 2026 and October 2026, detached houses: listings fell from 80 in June to 74 in October (−7.5%), and it took 12.9% of the city’s 294 sales over the period; condos and townhomes: listings rose from 11 in June to 16 in October (+45.5%), and it took 2.2% of the city’s 456 sales over the period.

The monthly write-ups singled out Elgin Chantrell for detached houses in September (a sellers’ best bet); detached houses in June, July (a buyers’ best bet); condos and townhomes in June (a sellers’ best bet); condos and townhomes in October (a buyers’ best bet).

blocks.text: Lots and land in Elgin Chantrell

items.t: Lot fabric: The feed snapshot is dominated by detached estate homes on the 24 Avenue, 32 Avenue and Crescent Road corridors, plus the one land card noted above.

Fee-simple lots are the default form: a detached house or acreage lot here is fee-simple unless title says otherwise — no strata corporation, no Form B, no strata fees. A sub-area-wide strata-versus-freehold split is not verified.

: a bare-land strata lot IS strata tenure on the lot itself — Form B, strata fees and registered bylaws apply; it is NOT fee-simple. No bare-land strata plan inside Elgin Chantrell was verified — no such plan is named or counted, and tenure on any specific parcel is a title question.

Assemblies / development sites / rezoning proposals, documented AS SUCH, never as inventory: none is documented in this sub-area's research. The Nicomekl Riverfront Park is a City park project in three phases, not a development site and not land inventory.

ALR vs non-ALR split: the research documents ALR status as a live parcel-by-parcel check in this pocket but publishes no split and no parcel result — none is stated. Check the parcel by PID or address in the ALC's ALR Property and Map Finder before pricing any acreage lot.

blocks.text: Streets, schools and getting around Elgin Chantrell

items.t: Sub-area medians are not published (Not verified).

Schools (Ministry-listed names and addresses only): Chantrell Creek Elementary, 2575 137 St; Elgin Park Secondary, 13484 24 Ave (level read from its name — the Ministry level field mislabels it); Crescent Park Elementary, 2440 128 St, at the pocket's western end.

Parks and heritage ground: Sunnyside Acres is a 140-hectare park of natural second-growth forest with about four kilometres of nature trails. Elgin Heritage Park / Historic Stewart Farm sits on Crescent Road on the Nicomekl River — the Stewart Farmhouse at 13723 Crescent Road (Bylaw 7823) and Elgin Heritage Park itself (Bylaw 12922) are City-designated heritage entries. The City's Nicomekl Riverfront Park will be a 3-km, 80-acre linear park on the south side of the Nicomekl River from Elgin Road to 40 Avenue, in three phases.

Transit: TransLink's Route 352 timetable routes it via 152 St, 16 Ave, 128 St, Crescent Rd and King George Blvd through South Surrey Park & Ride — the Crescent Road corridor through this pocket is a TransLink bus corridor. Commute times in minutes: Not verified.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect land buyers in Elgin Chantrell

items.t: Zoning: Surrey Zoning By-law No. 12000: — parcel zoning confirmed per parcel in COSMOS.
RA (Acreage Residential) figures — HELD not verified: The coach-house figures that do apply to RA lots (35–75 m², up to 120 m² below maximum FAR) are confirmed separately below.

SSMUH / added units (Surrey framework, from Jul 8, 2024): a maximum of 3 units on lots smaller than 280 m², 4 units on lots larger than 280 m², and up to 6 units on eligible lots of at least 281 m² within 400 m of a frequent bus stop, on eligible residential lots under 4,050 m² within the Urban Containment Boundary — acreage ground at or over that size, or off community services, sits outside the standard framing and needs a parcel check. Added-unit permission is NOT permission to subdivide.

Secondary suites (Bylaw No. 12000): one secondary suite per single family, semi-detached or duplex dwelling unit; not permitted within a coach house or garden suite; habitable floor area may not exceed 40% of the principal dwelling unit; no 90 m² cap was found in the current consolidated text; a suite is not a separate strata lot.

Heritage: Elgin Heritage Park and the Stewart Farmhouse at 13723 Crescent Road are City-designated heritage entries (Bylaws 12922 and 7823) — a property in the Crescent Road heritage cluster needs its heritage status checked before renovation or subdivision plans are priced.

ALR block (applies parcel-by-parcel where ALR ground exists here): subdivision within the ALR requires ALC approval; ALR residences cannot be stratified (ALC Bulletin 09 s.6; SPA s.239; ALCA s.21(1)); caps: principal ≤500 m², suite within principal only, additional residence 90 m² (≤40 ha) / 186 m² (>40 ha); local zoning may further restrict. Farm class is three-tier — $2,500 on 0.8–4 ha / $2,500 + 5% of value over 4 ha / $10,000 under 0.8 ha, applications by Oct 31 — a flat "$2,500+" line is an ERROR, and no farm-class claim is asserted for any parcel here.

blocks.text: Good to know about Elgin Chantrell

items.t: The name on the listing is a board label, not a legal boundary. There is no City map for "Elgin Chantrell" — a search, a plan check or a catchment claim run under that name alone will miss; run the parcel in COSMOS and the address in the ALC finder and the SD36 locator instead.
The attached shelf can record zero sales in a month without the pocket being dead.

A title conflict sits on one of the pocket's two townhouse complexes — and it is not a land question. It is recorded here only so a land buyer searching by complex name does not mistake the complex for lot stock.

The riverfront park is a plan, phased, not a finished amenity. The Nicomekl Riverfront Park is a 3-km, 80-acre City project in three phases extending east from Elgin Road — price the phases as the City states them, not as completed parkland.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect duplexes in Elgin Chantrell

items.t: Plan and zoning (Surrey): Surrey OCP = Bylaw 21900 (Surrey 2050, adopted Jun 15, 2026) — Bylaw 18020 is never cited as current; Zoning Bylaw No. 12000 governs this pocket. No City land use plan is named for Elgin or Chantrell, so a parcel's zone under Bylaw 12000 drives what can be built on it. Servicing Bylaw 8830 (1986) is verified from City pages. Surrey has no Supreme Court registry (mapping not verified). Streamside setbacks sit in Part 7A of Zoning 12000 and vary by stream class — no single riparian figure is ever stated.

SSMUH and suites (Surrey): SSMUH allows a maximum of 3 units on lots smaller than 280 m², 4 units on lots larger than 280 m², and up to 6 units on eligible lots of at least 281 m² within 400 m of a frequent bus stop; the City adopted the SSMUH zoning changes on July 8, 2024 — duplexes are the baseline form. One secondary suite may be permitted per single family, semi-detached or duplex dwelling unit; a suite is not permitted within a coach house or garden suite; and a suite's habitable floor area may not exceed 40% of the principal dwelling unit — Surrey's own cap, never borrowed; no 90 m² cap is a current rule. All Surrey residential zones that allow detached houses, duplexes and houseplexes also allow a coach house or garden suite of at least 35 m² and at most 75 m², rising to 120 m² for lots zoned RA, R2, R2-O and R3 where the existing house or duplex is below maximum FAR, with one extra parking space required.

ALR parcels follow the ALC housing frame — one principal residence at a maximum of 500 m² plus at most one additional residence of 90 m² (parcels ≤40 ha) or 186 m² (parcels >40 ha); ALR status is a parcel-by-parcel check in the ALC's ALR Property and Map Finder. The guide page states Elgin Heritage Park's own parcel is zoned partly A1 and partly RA, and part of it is in the ALR (site copy).

faq.q: Is Elgin Chantrell an official City neighbourhood?
faq.a: Compare a lot against its actual street and parcel, not the label.

faq.q: Can I buy a vacant acreage lot here?
faq.a: No named bare-land subdivision or lot offering was verified. The feed snapshot carried one land listing card, but land here generally trades as the existing estate/acreage fabric, parcel by parcel.

faq.q: Is my lot on sewer and water, or well and septic?
faq.a: Never assume servicing from the acreage label.

faq.q: Is the parcel in the ALR, and what changes if it is?
faq.a: Check the ALC finder by PID/address. If it is in the ALR: subdivision needs ALC approval, residences cannot be stratified, the principal is capped at 500 m² with a suite inside it only, and one additional residence is capped at 90 m² / 186 m² by parcel size.

faq.q: Can an acreage home here add a suite or a coach house?
faq.a: One suite per unit at ≤40% of the principal unit, never inside a coach house; a coach house/garden suite of 35–75 m², up to 120 m² on RA lots below maximum FAR, one extra parking space — and on ALR parcels the ALC frame applies first.

faq.q: Is Elgin Pointe a duplex I can buy half of?
faq.a: "Duplex-style" describes the paired built form; each unit is a strata townhouse, not a half duplex in either legal form.

faq.q: The Crescent Road rancher has a legal suite — is it a duplex?
faq.a: Per its listing text it is a single house with a suite, not a duplex in either legal form on any primary source here. A Surrey suite is capped at 40% of the principal dwelling unit's habitable floor area, and suite legality is a per-parcel check.
